changes.description:
R2 (2026-10-08) REPLACES the R1 description of this task (R1 text retained in git history and in the superseded plan). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-08-163f-r2-step-0c-evidence-on-192f-record-plan.md, unit U1 and section "Ordering contract". Deliberation: docs/decisions/2026-10-08-171s-regrounding-and-reconcile-hygiene-deliberation.md D-1/D-2.

Write RED tests in a new tests/test_cascade_evidence_temporal_ordering.py (stdlib unittest, temp-dir fixtures; reuse evidence fixture builders from tests/test_cli_gate_closure_evidence.py where present). Cases:
- Rule 1 (cascade records): pre_close.captured_at < invocation.started_at <= invocation.finished_at passes; captured_at after started_at fails; finished_at before started_at fails; unparseable timestamp fails.
- Rule 2 (both close paths, engine-anchored window [M = merge commit committer time, C = pre_close.captured_at)): a manifest member engine-log `archived` event inside the window fails (the 159-S shape: post-hoc --classify-only); member archived before M passes (late-but-legit pre-archived); `commit_tracked`/`comment`/status->done events inside the window pass; mixed offsets (-07:00 vs Z) compared as UTC instants.
- Rule 3: unresolvable M fails; missing log for a member recorded not-archived in pre_close fails; missing log for a member recorded archived at capture warns and passes; malformed log line fails.
- Passing fixture modelled on real 169-S data (C 05:02:03Z, started 05:02:17Z, finished 05:21:30Z, member archived 05:14:25Z, M 04:48:32Z); failing fixture = same with captured_at 05:30:00Z.
Inject merge-commit time through a seam so no real git repo is needed. Tests MUST fail before 163.002-T/163.004-T land.

Acceptance: new test module fails RED for the right reason (missing checks), not import errors. Gate: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests.
Stash traceability: 856B6770, A9BABC8B.
changes.title: R2 U1 RED: 159-S-shape replay tests for closure-evidence temporal ordering
